newsitem.title: UK: Quebec plans $1.0 billion 10-year bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Quebec plans $1.0 billion 10-year bond - dealers.

text.p: Quebec could launch a $1.0 billion 10-year global bond in the coming weeks, syndicate managers said on Friday.
"If Qeubec thinks today's falls in U.S. Treasury bonds will not hurt the Eurobond market, the deal could come as early as next week," said a new issues trader.
Spread talk was around 60 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, dealers said.
Credit Suisse First Boston, Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch were tipped as lead managers.
"Quebec mandated CSFB, Goldman and Merrill a few months ago for a deal, but the timing has not been right," said a trader.
"They may decide to come next week, or they may hold off for a bit more," he said.
